sourceNote: Rice bag anchor: Lagos MAFA/Lagos.Cool tracker, mid-2026 (about ₦60,000 for 50kg long grain). Other figures are INDICATIVE editor estimates for October 2026. Replace from your own market check before publishing. Update this file daily.

items.name: Rice (local/foreign, 1kg)
items.note: 50kg bag long grain was about ₦60,000 in Lagos in mid-2026 per the state tracker.

items.name: Garri (white, 1kg)
items.note: Garri is usually cheapest in the South-East, where it is processed.

items.name: Brown beans / oloyin (1kg)
items.note: Beans prices rise in the lean season (roughly June to September).

items.name: Yam (white, 1kg)
items.note: Sold by tuber. This is the per-kg equivalent for a medium tuber.

items.name: Eggs (1 piece, medium)
items.note: A crate of 30 is usually cheaper per egg. Check for cracks before buying.

items.name: Palm oil (1 litre)
items.note: Gallon-size buys are cheaper per litre.

items.name: Fresh tomatoes (1kg)
items.note: Tomatoes swing hard. A bad rainy week can double them.

items.name: Fresh pepper mix (1kg)
items.note: Scotch bonnet and atarodo mixed. Price depends on the week.

items.name: Onions (1kg)
items.note: Kano onions usually come in from the North after harvest.

items.name: Ground crayfish (1kg)
items.note: Buy a small pack first to check for salt and sand.

items.name: Beef (1kg, with bone)
items.note: Beef prices track cattle supply from the North.

items.name: Chicken (broiler, 1kg)
items.note: Live birds are cheaper than dressed. Dressing costs extra.

items.name: Mackerel / titus (1kg)
items.note: Frozen fish is often cheaper per kg than fresh.

items.name: Sugar (1kg, granulated)
items.note: Brand matters more than city here.

items.name: Egusi / melon seeds (1kg)
items.note: Shelled egusi is pricier. Check for mould before buying.

items.name: Okra (1kg)
items.note: Okra is seasonal in some states.

items.name: Ugu (fluted pumpkin leaves, per bunch)
items.note: Price is per bunch. Bunches vary in size, so weigh if you can.

cityIndexNote: Cities without explicit prices use the Lagos range scaled by the costIndex in cities.json.
